# <type>(<scope>): <short description>
# |<---- max 72 characters ---->|
#
# Types: feat | fix | refactor | test | chore | docs | perf | style | revert
#
# Scopes: os | cliente | veiculo | servico | peca | estoque | orcamento |
#         auth | usuario | infra | db | api
#
# --- Examples ---
# feat(os): add status transition validation
# fix(estoque): prevent negative stock on concurrent decrements
# refactor(auth): extract JWT claims parsing to helper
# test(customer): add edge cases for CNPJ check digits
# chore(infra): update docker-compose postgres version
